summary: Iteration 6 (Snag Share Link + Referral Prompt) tests. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py. POST /api/snag-links returns {assignee,url} where url ends with /api/s/<token>; 400 when no snags are assigned to that name; 400 on blank name; case-insensitive assignee lookup returns the SAME existing token (idempotent); GET /api/snag-links lists active project links; auth required. Public GET /api/s/{token} HTML renders only the matching assignee's snags, contains #snag-count ('1 open · 0 fixed' pre-fix and '0 open · 1 fixed' post-fix), per-open-snag a multipart form POSTing to /api/s/{token}/fix/{sid} with inputs photo + note (enctype=multipart/form-data), includes #trial-cta with href containing ref=snag&by=<owner_user_id>; invalid token returns 'no longer active' page. POST /api/s/{token}/fix/{sid} with a PNG upload returns 303 redirect to ?done=1, flips snag.status=fixed, sets fixed_by=assignee, fix_note=<trimmed>, fix_photo_path; fixing a snag that isn't assigned to that trade returns 404; GET /api/s/{token}/photo/{sid}?kind=fix returns the stored image (content-type image/*); public page afterward shows #snag-fixed-msg. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844) walked via UI: logged in with demo@mybuilder.app via sign-in button -> auth form -> home. Tapped quick-action-snags -> snags-share-button -> snag-share-sheet renders. With no assigned snags, snag-share-empty is shown. After seeding one snag assigned to 'TEST_Trade_UI', the sheet shows snag-share-row-test_trade_ui and snag-share-send-test_trade_ui; tapping Send on web copied the URL to the clipboard (verified via navigator.clipboard.readText -> https://.../api/s/<token>) and showed the 'Snag link copied' toast. snag-form shows snag-assignee-chip-<contactId> chips sourced from team contacts (3 chips rendered for demo). referral-prompt card is visible on /share-report with text 'Invite a lender, get a free month' + subcopy showing 'You've earned 0 so far'. Deprecated packages detected: none. Note: when running test_iteration6 together with test_iteration5 in parallel, 2 of the 13 cases fail because iteration-5's module cleanup wipes db.snags/db.snag_links from the demo project between fixtures — pure test-interaction, not a product bug.
action_items: No blockers. Iteration 6 (snag share links + referral prompt) is production-ready.

Housekeeping: iteration-5 pytest module cleanup deletes ALL snags for the demo project, which breaks parallel runs with iteration-6 fixtures. Consider scoping cleanup to TEST_-prefixed documents only, or add a module-scoped seed snag for iteration-5 instead of relying on existing seeded ones.
(Carried over) server.py is 1676 lines - router split still overdue; snag-link endpoints add +120 lines.
(Carried over) RN Web shadow* -> boxShadow deprecation warning still present.
critical_code_review_comments: assignee_query uses regex ^<escaped>$ with 'i' flag for case-insensitive match - correct. Trimmed before use.
create_snag_link stores assignee_lc for the dedupe key and preserves the original casing in assignee; good.
public_fix_snag combines assignee_query with _id to enforce ownership on the trade side; nice defence-in-depth.
public_fix_snag enforces 10MB photo cap and sanitises note to 500 chars - good.
public_snags page sorts by status (open first) and shows a disabled card with the fix photo once fixed - good UX.
SnagShareSheet correctly groups by case-insensitive assignee and preserves the original casing for display and API call.
On web, SnagShareSheet copies URL + toast; on mobile with matching contact phone it opens wa.me - good fallback chain.
referral-prompt is a static card (no CTA button) - the backend already drives credit via /api/share and /api/q links; copy is clear.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted: 1 snag ('TEST_UI_defect_silicone_gap' assigned to 'TEST_Trade_UI') + 1 db.snag_links doc, via the demo account. Verified post-cleanup: 0 TEST_ snags, 0 remaining snag-links for demo, demo trial_ends=2026-11-13 unchanged, no new users/referrals created. Pytest fixtures auto-clean their own TEST_Trade_<uuid> snag + snag_link via teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-6 adds POST/GET /api/snag-links, public GET/POST /api/s/{token}[+/fix/{sid}, /photo/{sid}], SnagShareSheet component, snag-assignee-chip-<id> chips in snag-form, snag-fixed-by-<id>/snag-fix-evidence/snag-fix-photo testIDs on fixed snags, and the referral-prompt card on share-report. All pytest-iteration6 cases pass in isolation. If running the full /app/backend/tests/ suite, note that iteration-5 wipes demo project snags; iteration-6 should be run first or isolated.
